primary_meaning: Jesus Christ as the ultimate, unblemished sacrifice for human sin, fulfilling the Old Testament sacrificial system (especially the Passover lamb), and reigning as the victorious, slain-yet-living King in Revelation.

alternatives.meaning: A fierce, apocalyptic conqueror and judge who executes God's wrath upon the wicked.
The historical Passover sacrifice representing God's deliverance of Israel from Egypt and judgment.
Vulnerable followers of Christ or believers in need of pastoral care.

notes: The identification of 'The Lamb' (Agnus Dei) with Jesus Christ is one of the most universal and settled symbols in Christian theology, bridging the Old Testament sacrificial system with New Testament atonement theology and apocalyptic victory.
